description: This Java source file defines the 'FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException' class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that feature properties are either missing or inaccessible due to permissions. It includes related builder classes and methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and extends runtime exception classes relevant to this project.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating feature property inaccessibility or absence.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception with specified ThingId and featureId.

methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a message string and headers.
